extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet identifies the device as Si2309CDS, Vishay Siliconix, and lists SI2309CDS-T1-GE3 as the exact ordering variant; the requested manufacturer identity is retained as Vishay Intertech.
P-channel voltage and current magnitudes are represented as positive numeric values; signed p-channel bias and current conventions are preserved in conditions and plot-axis descriptions.

Output, transfer, and capacitance points are compact direct readings from the plotted traces on page 3 and are approximate digitizations, not interpolated values. The VGS = 5 V output trace is the lowest trace in the plotted VGS = 10 through 5 V family.
The datasheet publishes typical and maximum RDS(on) values at VGS = -10 V and -4.5 V; all four schema-compatible table entries are transcribed.
The threshold table provides minimum and maximum values but no typical threshold value, so threshold_typ is null.
